correctness.rationale: Under a uniform random permutation the mixed pattern statistic is a sum of bounded symmetric order-3 and order-4 U-statistics. Their one-point conditionals are 1/3+P(x)P(y)/6 and 1/8-P(x)P(y)/8; multiplied by 3 and 4 the centered first projections cancel pointwise. The canonical second kernel K is explicitly defined by the rank-placement conditional formulas; symbolic rational integration verifies squared Hilbert-Schmidt norm 121/3600. Hoeffding remainder has L2 size O(n^-3/2). The canonical order-two spectral theorem yields n(T_n-11/24) converging to the centered quadratic-normal series, and n² variance to 121/1800. The nonzero norm implies positive fourth cumulant. The standalone packaged checker confirmed independent finite n=4,5,6,7 exact distributions and the kernel integrals; this supports, rather than substitutes for, the analytical limit argument.
